description: Queues a Request indexing click for a URL of one of the user's sites, also one that is not a page of the site yet. The user's IndexMachine Chrome extension performs it in their own Search Console when it next checks in, within about 10 requests per site per day; the answer has the queue position and the ETA in eta_text, which is for the click and not for indexing. It previews first, and queues nothing for a page that is already indexed unless force is true, a re-index. A re-index, a URL that is not in the sitemap, or the site's last request of the day waits for the user's yes. Clients that can ask their user (MCP elicitation) get a question to confirm, and the answer does not pass through the model; with other clients the tool refuses first with a confirm token, and the call with that token stands for the user's yes.

confirm.description: The confirm token from this tool's refusal, once the user agreed

force.description: Request a re-index of a page that is already indexed

url.description: A whole http or https URL of one of the user's sites

name: request_indexing
title: Request indexing
